title: Left boundary cell
statement: For a natural-number parameter, a machine configuration on a fixed Boolean input, and a natural-number cell index, define the left neighbor encoding to be the blank cell encoding when the index is zero; otherwise it is the configuration's cell encoding at index one less than the given index.
caveat: The definition of the configuration's cell encoding is not included in the supplied statement.
